parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of your WAF instance.

parameters.name: LabelType
parameters.description: The type of bot rule tag to query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 20. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token for the next page. If a value is returned for this parameter, the next page exists.

> If this parameter has a return value, the next page exists. Use the returned NextToken value as a request parameter to retrieve the next page of data. Repeat until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SubScene
parameters.description: The type of bot management protection scenario.
